slogan.en: One CLI unifies development, builds, testing, linting, and formatting across all your JavaScript projects. Powered by the Rspack ecosystem.
slogan.zh: 只需一个 CLI，即可统一所有 JavaScript 项目的开发、构建、测试、代码检查与格式化。由 Rspack 生态驱动。

unifiedCliDesc.en: Develop, build, test, lint, format code, build libraries, and serve docs with the rs command.
unifiedCliDesc.zh: 通过 rs 命令完成开发、构建、测试、检查、格式化、库构建和文档开发。

oneConfigDesc.en: Configure the whole toolchain from a single rstack.config.ts file.
oneConfigDesc.zh: 在一份 rstack.config.ts 中配置完整工具链。

ecosystemPoweredDesc.en: Built on Rspack, Rsbuild, Rslib, Rstest, Rslint, and Rspress.

workflowFriendlyDesc.en: Keep using your preferred runtime, package manager, and task runner.
workflowFriendlyDesc.zh: 继续使用你熟悉的运行时、包管理器和任务编排工具。
